summary: Read-only investigation of GitHub Bridge Action Resolution (github-issues.js, github-bridge.js) at base commit 88869a92 (== origin/main). Found two concrete, statically-verified parser defects distinct from #113's bullet-prefix fix: (1) pickAction/pickPriority/pickModel/pickInt read only sections.<key>[0], which is a blank line (falsy) when a scalar field is written as a heading followed by a blank line before its value (GitHub Issue Forms style) or as a markdown table row (no colon) — both silently drop an intended explicit Action to default/inherited; (2) notes/objective text is truncated (short() at 2000/4000/8000 chars), observable directly in this task's own truncated prompt, though this does not affect Action resolution since the scalar-field scan runs pre-truncation. Could not confirm which mechanism (if either) explains #114/#115 specifically, or verify the production runtime's actual checkout HEAD, because Bash execution of node/git-outside-worktree and gh/WebFetch network calls all required interactive approval unavailable in this headless investigate session -- the same restriction gh-issue-114's investigate run hit. Action/execution_profile cannot diverge today by construction (profile is always freshly derived server-side from requested_action at claim time; no ACTION_PROFILE_MISMATCH failure mode exists to trigger). Rerun precedence (explicit > inherited > default) and per-attempt immutability of the action/profile decision are correctly implemented as read, matching #114's independent conclusion. Evidence flagged for the mission owner: gh-issue-115's claim that Issue #114 explicitly stated Action: implement is contradicted by gh-issue-114.json's own intake notes (written by the current parser), and gh-issue-116 itself carries no Action:/action:<x> label either -- recommend resolving this via gh api against the live issue bodies once network-approved Bash is available, before assuming the parser is at fault for these specific three issues.
